pricing_refresh_note: Refreshed 2026-09-24 against GitHub's models-and-pricing page. The model names in this roster's 2026-09 refresh were also observed in this account's Copilot CLI /model picker without sending a model prompt. Direct zero-prompt CLI checks confirmed every newly introduced --model slug in this file, with 0 AIC used.
model_ids_note: Roster membership is based on GitHub's public Copilot CLI model matrix plus a 2026-09-24 account /model picker check and zero-prompt CLI checks. `gpt-6-astra`, `gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-6-luna`, `claude-fable-5.1`, `claude-opus-5.5`, `gemini-3.8-flash`, `mai-code-1.1-flash`, `grok-4.7`, and `kimi-k3` each opened with its expected display name and used 0 AIC. File order controls the no-preference default for each tier: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and GPT-6 Luna lead their respective lanes. Fable models are available but deliberately do not lead frontier because GitHub documents Anthropic's default retention caveat. Retired models live only in `retired_models`: `bin/copilot_usage.py` may price historical logs from that map, while every routing, preference, forecast, and dispatch path scans active `models` only.

billing_unit.name: AIC
billing_unit.note: GitHub AI Credit. All model usage is token-metered (input, cached input, output; Anthropic models plus the GPT-5.6 and GPT-6 families also bill cache writes) and settled in AIC. Code completions and next-edit suggestions are not billed in AIC.

free.note: Small allowance that varies; see the plans page.

business.note: AIC pooled at the org level; per-seat allowance not fixed here.

enterprise.note: AIC pooled at the org level; per-seat allowance not fixed here.

plans_note: Individual paid plans = base credits matched 1:1 to the subscription price plus a flex allotment GitHub can rebalance as model economics change. Max = $200/mo = 20,000 AIC.

knobs.reasoning_efforts_note: Display-form ladder, ascending. Copilot CLI v1.0.83 --help and GitHub's CLI command reference confirm headless `--effort=LEVEL` and `--reasoning-effort=LEVEL` flags with low|medium|high|xhigh|max values; this list renders those values in the picker-style display form. The /model picker also supports per-model interactive adjustment with left/right arrows. This repository's copilot_execute.py does NOT yet forward either effort flag, so execution-kit runs cannot select effort through the driver; use a direct Copilot CLI invocation or the picker when effort control is required. Do not infer a model's effort support merely from its appearance in this list.

long_context_note: GitHub's current pricing page supplies the long-context rates modeled on GPT-5.4, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6, GPT-6, and Grok rows. Long-context rates apply when a single request exceeds the model-specific input threshold; cumulative session totals must not be used to infer that threshold crossing.
